description: Land Title Settlement Department - Niwithigala, Niwithigala D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad.Map No. 620400
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement processes, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
